text:
Getting rid of the Ether. Could Physics have achieved it sooner, with better assistance from Philosophy? | THEORIA. An International Journal for Theory, History and Foundations of Science 

 

 Published 18-12-2009 

 Roberto Torretti 

## Abstract

 The history of the luminiferous ether is sketched with a view to ascertaining what factors may have kept this idea alive until 1905, when Einstein declared it superfluous.
